purpose: Spatial six-revolute-joint kinematic demonstrator; no payload, strength or motor-sizing claim
architecture: Serial Z-Y-Y-X-Y-Z, offset three-axis wrist; seven structural links and six independent joint coordinates
joint_connection: Parent boss and shaft/collar rigidly bonded; child boss and sleeve rigidly bonded; coaxial bearing axis plus 0.6 mm face separation leaves one rotation. Hardware bonds idealize a clamp; threads and drive hardware are outside this kinematic experiment.
checks: Every part single solid, feature errors zero, body consistency zero, sketch DOF zero
Six relative revolute DOFs; native Motion unactuated Gruebler six, driven zero
Every static body pair, every cross-link body pair at every output frame
Actual native link matrices versus independently calculated product-of-exponentials FK
Sampled workspace is an analytical estimate, separately label native checked trajectory
All PRT and STEP reopen; NX process cold restart and SIM/result playback
design_reason: Raised elbow separates base and working links. Orthogonal offset wrist provides independent spatial orientation. 0.6 mm axial boss clearance and explicit sleeves/shafts avoid coincident solids; thin struts are visualization geometry, not a load-rated design. Joint limits bound the demonstrated working range.
